subject: POC roadmap and model selection — LinguaTech trial planning
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anika Mehta <anika@linguatech.com>, Tom Walker <tom@linguatech.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: POC recap + proposed trial plan (post-call)

Hi Anika / Tom — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re all aligned.

Key business goals you shared:
- Improve suggestion quality for multilingual customer responses (EN / FR / DE)
- Reduce agent-average handling time by surfacing high-confidence suggested replies and extracted entities
- Keep latency sub-350ms p50 in the UI for targeted workflows

Immediate constraints:
- PII in samples must remain in-customer environment; we’ll only use hashed/anonymized examples for the evaluation set unless you provide a strict NDA/DSA.
- Trial budget window: 3 weeks preferred starting next Mon (you mentioned availability).

Proposed POC scope (high level):
1) Trial models: primary = Mistral-Instruct-7B (baseline for low-latency response and instruction tuning), fallback = Llama-2-13B (4-bit quantized) for tougher multilingual edge cases.
2) Evaluation set: 200 prompts (EN/FR/DE split ~60/20/20) — attached Prompt_Set_v1.csv
3) Success criteria (examples):
   - QA/extraction F1 >= 0.88 across combined set
   - Customer-rated helpfulness >= 4.2/5 on a 100-case blind review
   - End-to-end p50 latency < 350ms, p95 < 900ms
   - Throughput target: sustained 8-10 RPS during peak test runs
4) Ownership: Marissa (commercial lead), Rishi (SE / evaluation harness), Monica (post-trial adoption / CS).

Attachments: POC_Success_Criteria_v1.pdf and Prompt_Set_v1.csv (see Drive link below).

Can you confirm:
- if you’re comfortable starting a trial week of 2026-03-16?
- whether we can get a sample of 200 anonymized interactions by EOD Friday?

If that works I’ll send a formal week-by-week plan and schedule a 30-min kickoff with Rishi to align on access and metrics.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference — Developer-first high-performance LLM inference
From: Anika Mehta <anika@linguatech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Tom Walker <tom@linguatech.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Mar 2026 09:42:00 +0000
Subject: Re: POC recap + proposed trial plan (post-call)

Hi Marissa — high level looks good, thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications: 

- Timeline: yes, week of 16 March works for us; preference for a Fri (20th) kickoff demo so we have internal stakeholders.
- Multilingual: French and German support is mandatory. The split you suggested is fine.
- Success criteria: the F1 target you listed is acceptable; additionally we’ll apply a small business-weighted metric that prioritizes named-entity extraction on product names (we’ll share a list).
- Data sharing: we can provide 200 anonymized interactions but we need a short DPA addendum in place first (we have legal working on this). Can Redwood support in-customer-only trial mode if DPA takes longer?

Also, can you confirm which model provides the best out-of-the-box handling for DE idioms? If not available, we need to know fallback behavior and a plan for prompt engineering/finetuning.

Thanks — Anika
Anika Mehta | Head of Product, LinguaTech Solutions
anika@linguatech.com | +44 20 7946 0123
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anika Mehta <anika@linguatech.com>, Tom Walker <tom@linguatech.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Mar 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC recap + proposed trial plan (post-call)

Great — thanks Anika. Answering the multilingual + fallback question and adding a slightly more detailed week-by-week plan below.

Model selection rationale:
- Primary: Mistral-Instruct-7B (hosted on Redwood) — strong instruction-following, low latency, and good multilingual baseline for EN/FR/DE with prompt templates.
- Fallback: Llama-2-13B (4-bit quantized) — we’ll route requests to this when we detect low-confidence or model-specific failure modes (long tail DE idioms). It often helps on harder multilingual edge cases when paired with tuned prompts.
- If LinguaTech prefers, we can swap in an alternate multilingual heavy model (e.g., BLOOMZ family) — Rishi can run a short A/B on the 200 prompts during week 1.

Proposed 3-week POC plan (compact):
Week 0 (pre-kickoff, by 3/20): legal DPA / access checklist, shared Drive folder, sample 200 anonymized interactions received.
Week 1 (3/20–3/26): baseline runs — run both primary and fallback across the 200 prompts, produce side-by-side metrics (F1, accuracy, latency), deliver topline report.
Week 2 (3/27–4/2): tuning — apply prompt engineering, small-context caching, and batching strategies; re-evaluate.
Week 3 (4/3–4/9): soak test — run sustained throughput tests, verify SLOs, collect customer-blind review (100 cases). Final success decision and next-steps planning.

Ownership:
- Commercial / timelines: me (Marissa)
- SE / evaluation harness + model runs: Rishi
- Adoption / post-trial: Monica

Data/privacy options: we can do an in-customer trial via Redwood Private if DPA delays you — Rishi can lay out the Quickstart steps. Otherwise, we can run on hosted with an enclosed sample set.

Next steps I’ll take now:
- Upload success criteria doc & prompt set to Drive and HubSpot record (links below).
- Schedule 30m kickoff for Fri 20 Mar — propose 10:00am GMT.

Can you confirm 10am GMT on 20 Mar and whether legal will need an initial template from us?

Thanks — Marissa
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Mar 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: Tech approach and infra estimates for LinguaTech POC

Marissa / Vivek — quick technical notes to ensure the week-1 runs are smooth. Keeping internal recipients only.

Short plan:
- Evaluation harness: I’ll spin up a reproducible runner that executes both Mistral-Instruct-7B and Llama-2-13B (4-bit) on the 200-prompt set and captures token-level timings, top-k confidence, and entity extraction F1.
- Routing: implement a fast confidence threshold at the runtime layer. Low-confidence answers (top prob < 0.55) route to Llama-2-13B for re-generation. We’ll capture the delta in metrics.
- Caching: enable prefix KV caching for repeated prefixes to cut p50 latency.

Infra estimate:
- Baseline: 1x A10G or single A100 40GB node should be sufficient for low-concurrency baseline runs (burst to verify p95). If we need to reproduce 8–10 RPS sustained at <350ms p50, we may need 1x A100 80GB or an autoscaled pool (I’ll provision for A100-80GB for week-3 soak).

Data/Access items needed from client:
- 200 anonymized interactions in CSV with columns: prompt, ground_truth, language_tag, product_entity_masked.
- Sample API key or VPC access if they want in-customer execution.
- SOC2 / DPA status — if not done, we’ll use Private evaluation or hashed samples only.

I’ll prepare two evaluation runs and the notebook for side-by-side review by Monday morning.

— Rishi
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Subject: Confirmed kickoff + next steps (Friday 20 Mar 10:00 GMT)

Anika / Tom — confirmed: kickoff scheduled for Fri 20 Mar at 10:00am GMT (calendar invite sent). Summary of next steps and owners below: 

1) Legal / access (Anika + Marissa): DPA addendum or decision on in-customer trial by 3/19.
2) Sample data (Anika): 200 anonymized interactions in Prompt_Set_v1.csv format by 3/19 EOD.
3) Kickoff (Rishi + LinguaTech + Marissa): align on test harness, confirm languages/tags, confirm evaluation rubric (3/20).
4) Week 1 runs (Rishi): baseline runs across Mistral-Instruct-7B and Llama-2-13B — deliver topline metrics by 3/26.
5) Week 2 tuning (Rishi + Monica): prompt tuning, caching, temporary quantization profiles; deliver re-eval by 4/2.
6) Week 3 soak & blind review (Monica + LinguaTech): run sustained traffic, collect customer-blind feedback; final decision 4/9.

Attached: Proposal_Trial_Terms.docx, POC_Success_Criteria_v1.pdf (also in Drive). HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567 — please comment on the record if any stakeholder changes.

If anything changes to access or timelines, flag immediately. Looking forward to working together — see you on the 20th.

Best — Marissa
